subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI audio attachment shows 'message too large' until manual refresh

question: Should this issue wait for live proof or a linked WebChat media-final PR to prove the exact oversized-audio first-render case, or should maintainers sponsor a separate focused Control UI hydration fix now?
rationale: Current main changed the UI event path enough that source inspection alone cannot prove the report fixed or still broken, and nearby open PRs overlap without owning this exact symptom.

options.title: Require Live Proof First
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a real Control UI/Gateway run with a large audio attachment before queueing a separate repair.

options.title: Use An Existing Media PR
options.body: Treat an open media-final PR as canonical only if maintainers verify it fixes this exact placeholder-until-refresh case after conflict resolution.

options.title: Sponsor A Focused Hydration Fix
options.body: Queue a narrow fix for oversized/truncated media final hydration if maintainers decide the current overlap should not block this user-visible bug.

recommendation.title: Require Live Proof First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a real Control UI/Gateway run with a large audio attachment before queueing a separate repair.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the historical final-event no-reload optimization and is the strongest available routing candidate for the UI hydration decision.
